summary: Webull Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a company statement dated October 9, 2026, responding to a report released by the U.S. House Select Committee. The disclosure is a press statement attached as Exhibit 99.1 and posted to the investor relations website, furnished rather than filed under Section 18, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics disclosed. This is a non-US issuer's equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K furnished under Item 7.01/8.01; no special-situation event is present. Watch for regulatory or congressional follow-up and any market reaction to the committee report.
